versions.content: AUTOSAR shall provide means to describe interfaces of the entire system Type: Valid Description: Well - defined interfaces are the key for exchangeability, reusability and the basis for the freedom of interference. Decomposition on interf ace level is essential for an appropriate clustering and partitioning in the AUTOSAR Application Software. Rationale: Principle: “divide and conquer” which is a key success factor in the development of large systems. Use Case: Development of large inter connected software systems with Main Requirements AUTOSAR FO R20 - 11 24 of 54 Document ID 54 : AUTOSAR_RS_Main a high degree of reuse, such as driving assistance systems.
